additional_concerns: All six candidates restrict scope to paragraph 14, whereas the selected responsibility duties arise under paragraph 10 and footnote 1; equivalence of those scopes is not established.

node.f189039671da0fc054c157bd, deferred.9d6ef75f1b5f4ae94e41f5d5 and deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897 equate an SFC demonstration request with satisfaction: the request establishes neither retained responsibility nor performance, and its absence establishes neither breach nor release from the continuing duties.
node.dfbeb05a271dfdc22f59b8d9, deferred.2249d844381920c4bb3ae2cf and deferred.481ce79be4fc0611266ee787 grant unconditional satisfaction within scope without source support.

Paragraph 14 places the request qualifier immediately before demonstration; confirmation remains separately stated, while footnote 5 describes confirmation and demonstration together without repeating the qualifier, creating a reading issue that none of the candidates resolves.

Paragraph 14 and footnote 5 require substantive confirmation and demonstration concerning soundness, ownership records and smart-contract integrity, including minimum compliance with paragraphs 10–13 and high confidence concerning vulnerabilities or security flaws; request existence implements none of these standards.

Paragraphs 15 and 16 separately attach requests to third-party audit or verification and satisfactory legal opinion; neither action nor its request can automatically substitute for paragraph 14 demonstration.

Retained responsibility, allocation of operational authority, supervisory conduct and actual operational or record-keeping outcomes are distinct; the supplied section 6.8 permits specified parties to maintain the register, and section 6.11C concerns valuation supervision rather than establishing a universal tokenisation supervision test.

The supplied intermediary provisions concern their specified activities and actors and cannot automatically supply missing Product Provider compliance tests; Part A factors, omitted footnote 2 and the complete paragraphs 10–13 remain unresolved dependencies.
